title: Bandit & RL Frontier Problem History
scope: Source-traceable open-problem history. A record may be currently open, partially resolved, resolved, negatively resolved, or resolved with an external formalization. Missing Lean code is tracked separately from mathematical openness.

status_semantics.resolved-formalized-external: A mathematical resolution is public and a separately maintained external Lean formalization is available; BanditRLlib does not claim local compilation.
status_semantics.resolved-peer-reviewed: A later peer-reviewed publication explicitly reports resolving/confirming the problem.
status_semantics.resolved-preprint: A current preprint explicitly reports resolving the problem; peer-review status is kept visible.
status_semantics.resolved-negative-preprint: A current preprint gives a negative answer to the proposed universal target.
status_semantics.partial-current-audit: There is substantial progress, but this audit did not establish that the full source question is closed.
status_semantics.source-open-current-audit: The primary source posed the problem and a targeted audit through the date above did not establish a closure; this is not a proof that no resolution exists.
status_semantics.audit-needed: Primary open-problem source is indexed, but current closure status still requires a dedicated literature audit.

problems.title: Gap-entropy conjecture and almost instance-wise optimal BAI

source.title: Open Problem: Best Arm Identification: Almost Instance-Wise Optimality and the Gap Entropy Conjecture

progress.title: Towards Instance Optimal Bounds for Best Arm Identification
progress.note: Major partial progress on upper/lower routes.

resolution.title: Gap Entropy and Almost Instance-Wise Optimal Best-Arm Identification
resolution.note: Public manuscript plus Lean 4 formalization by Jiarui Yao, Jiaxi Zhao and Xiangxin Zhou.

resolution.title: A positive resolution of the gap-entropy conjecture
resolution.note: Independent proof by P. M. Aronow, Nathan Kallus and Patrick Lopatto.

problems.graph_delta: Adds a BAI-specific information-complexity branch: gap groups → normalized complexity masses → entropy; permutation-averaged instance benchmark; measurable adaptive sampling/stopping; lower-bound change-of-measure; universal algorithm; policy-representation equivalences.

problems.title: Does fixed-budget BAI admit an instance complexity matching the static oracle?

source.title: Open Problem: Optimal Best Arm Identification with Fixed-Budget

resolution.title: Fundamental Limitations of Fixed-Budget Best-Arm Identification
resolution.note: Motti Goldberger gives a negative answer for K≥3 in one-parameter natural exponential families: no algorithm uniformly matches the static-oracle exponent.

problems.graph_delta: A negative-resolution case should connect oracle allocation geometry, change of measure and impossibility of one uniform instance-complexity functional.

problems.title: Regret minimization with unknown heavy-tail parameters
problems.posed_by: Gianmarco Genalti and Alberto Maria Metelli

source.title: Open Problem: Regret Minimization in Heavy-Tailed Bandits with Unknown Distributional Parameters

resolution.title: Parameter-Free Heavy-Tailed Bandits
resolution.note: The authors state that they resolve the COLT 2025 problem without extra distributional assumptions and characterize the adaptation cost.

problems.graph_delta: High-value bridge from robust mean estimation/concentration to bandit regret, with lower-bound adaptation tradeoffs and scheduled exploration.

problems.title: First-order regret bounds for contextual bandits

resolution.note: Allen-Zhu, Bubeck and Li explicitly state that their method resolves the COLT 2017 open problem.

problems.graph_delta: Useful historical shortcut case: policy-space augmentation changes how first-order online-learning machinery reaches contextual partial feedback.

problems.title: Model selection for contextual bandits

source.title: Open Problem: Model Selection for Contextual Bandits

progress.note: Further positive guarantees under explicit realizability/model-class conditions.

problems.graph_delta: Connects contextual-bandit regret to nested classes, misspecification tests, bias/variance adaptation and impossibility nodes.
